name: Weekly
description: Paid every week — 52 paychecks per year
longDescription: Weekly pay is the most frequent pay schedule. You receive 52 paychecks per year, each representing approximately 1/52 of your annual salary.

name: Biweekly
description: Paid every two weeks — 26 paychecks per year
longDescription: Biweekly pay is the most common pay schedule in the US. You receive 26 paychecks per year, each representing approximately 1/26 of your annual salary.

name: Semimonthly
description: Paid twice a month — 24 paychecks per year
longDescription: Semimonthly pay means you are paid on two fixed dates each month (typically the 1st and 15th). You receive 24 paychecks per year.

name: Monthly
description: Paid once a month — 12 paychecks per year
longDescription: Monthly pay means one paycheck per month — 12 per year. Each paycheck represents your full monthly earnings minus all taxes and deductions.
